head: 7a2c8b9
summary: Third confirmation round, on 7a2c8b9. git diff --stat 8467f01 HEAD -- src touches only 04_shaders.js, 07_shell.js, 09_seats.js, 09b_py.js, 09d_suite.js and 12_scene.js. 10_mono.js and 05_layout.js are unchanged, so the monument geometry, materials and atlas are the same as the build I rated 8.8. Old vs new pixel diff (share of pixels with |dL|>8 / |d(B-R)|>8): 0.00/0.00 % in q01, q19, m01, m03, m05 and m12. q11 is 0.18/0.10 % and m06 0.29/0.18 %, both in a small distant patch (q11 x614-674 y181-239), not on the bar. The changes are in the PY views, all from L17/L18 pyCool/pyLvl: q13 23.3/9.4 %, m08 48.3/38.7 %, m10 31.0/17.3 % and m09 46.5/43.2 %. The intended PY changes move the monuments toward py_37302. Rear-wall whites in q13 went from L208 B-R +3 to L190 +10.5 (photo L227 +8). The right partition went from L218 +2 to L211 +10 (photo +17). The PY face of the J/PY bulkhead in m08 went from +8 to +23 (L17 note: py_37301/37303 lower whites +25..+36). One unintended side effect counts as a lighting regression: the aft-facing door-4 forward galley in m09 now takes the full PY cool share above about 1.4 m. Its upper cart bank reads blue-grey (B-R -5 -> +13, L138 -> 115) over a neutral lower bank (B-R -5..-10), which brings back the split at the work deck that 71fdda1 had fixed. That is lighting, not scored, but I raise it as a medium for the integrator. Geometry and proportion are rated afresh and unchanged: the bar keeps the in-service face, and the door-1, door-2, F wall, lav, door-4 and door-5 units are unchanged. The carried lows (flat nosing, cabinet reading as open shelving, flat control panel, crushed bay, black soffit, w18-w21 detail) remain. Score 8.8, no high or medium monument issue, one medium lighting item (not scored).
lighting_note: Not scored. (1) MEDIUM, new regression from L17/L18: the door-4 forward galley face (m09, aft-facing, its face at about dz[3][0] = 43.7) sits inside the pyM ramp. pyM ends with smoothstep(u_pyCool.y - 0.3, u_pyCool.y), and the face and its cart doors set back from z1 sit before that end. The L18 0.4 reduction only applies to forward-facing faces (step(0.5, -N.z)), so this aft face takes pyCool 0.9 and pyLvl 0.65 above the 1.4-1.7 m gate. Measured in m09, white pixels L>110 by band: rows 2-35 % L138 B-R -5 -> L115 +13; rows 40-68 % L123 -7 -> L121 -5; rows 70-85 % unchanged (L167 -3). On the column profile of x600-740, upper cart doors run B-R +12.6..+13.1 down to y160, then -4..-10 below the deck (y280-360): a 20-point hue step and about 20 L at the work-deck line. The comment in 04_shaders.js says 'the door-4 zone and its galleys stay out (z end)', but they do not. Fix: keep aft-facing faces near the zone end out, e.g. pyM *= 1.0 - step(0.5, N.z) * smoothstep(u_pyCool.y - 1.0, u_pyCool.y - 0.7, v_wpos.z). The galley is about 0.6 m deep, and only the galley faces there are above 1.4 m and aft-facing. Alternatively, end the ramp for N.z>0.5 at the galley's z0. Target: m09 upper vs lower bank within 3 B-R, upper L back to about 138, as on 8467f01. (2) Intended PY changes look right for the monuments: q13 rear wall +10.5 (photo +8), right partition +10 (photo +17), m08 PY bulkhead face +23. The q13 rear wall now reads L190 vs photo L227, which is slightly dim but within exposure tolerance (low, optional). (3) Carried: m05 right bay crushed to L3, no local reflections on the counter, black soffit over the bar. (4) q19 and m12 (door-5 galleys) are pixel-identical to 8467f01: the 71fdda1 fix holds there.
